event_summary: A blue round object and a yellow ball enter from opposite sides on a tabletop, meet near the center, then separate and stop apart.
raw_event_description: The video begins with an empty light woodgrain tabletop framed by two black cylindrical objects near the left and right edges. After a still interval, a small blue round object appears from the left side and a yellow spherical ball appears from the right side. They move toward each other across the tabletop, come into contact or very close contact near the center, then move away from that meeting point. The blue object moves back toward the left side, while the yellow ball moves toward the upper-right area. Both objects remain visible and stationary at separated positions near the end.

reasons: The tabletop and side black cylindrical objects are visible.
The blue and yellow moving objects are not visible in the first frame.
